preservation_policy: Every DOCX detail is preserved either as candidate cards, evidence, caveat/review item, query/rule/validation text, or raw source capture appendix. Out-of-scope means do not create forbidden card types, not discard content.
refactor_notes: Removed process_variant cards whose evidence only described return/settlement labels rather than materially different process sequences.
Rebuilt forward and reverse workflow cards from the DOCX lifecycle flows with concrete tables, columns, transaction_type values, and settlement/payment touchpoints.
Replaced section-heading metrics and placeholder formulas with executable SQL/formula semantics or recast them as value/rule context.
Corrected relationship cards to match the DOCX join map, including payments.utr_no_=settlement.settlement_id and non_order.sub_order_no=settlement.item_id for TDS.
Added SQL pattern registry entries for every executable query pattern and removed filter-only query patterns.
Encoded observed benchmark/context values on metric cards as guidance only, not hard validation thresholds.
Kept group_level_id=22 and seller/bank/logistics identifiers as column-level scope specs/caveats only.
